status: Exploratory analysis. Prior announcement/effective-date return patterns and Claude T29 are known; this is not a preregistration or independent confirmation.
primary_population: OMXSB additions with AD calendar years2017–2025 inclusive, observed daily total returns; no trimming by realized return. All known reviews retained, no min-power threshold selected after data.
primary_comparison: Buy at AD+1 trading-day close versus implementation close ED-1. AD+1 is chosen to ensure a full public day irrespective of announcement intraday time. Require early close strictly before implementation close.
return_definition: At early close allocate1SEK to event stock rather than OMXSBGI until implementation close. Compounded total return stock minus benchmark. Deletion secondary reverses the two positions. Gross marked-to-market comparison, not observed executions or a self-financing full replication portfolio.
secondary: Deletions; older2007–2016 context; 2026 separate partial-year context; AD+2 same-sample timing sensitivity. Known deletion flags are displayed and a flagged-exclusion sensitivity reported, not presented as exante-tradable filtering.
data_rules: No zero fill for missing total return. Nonfinite or <=-100% returns unavailable. Report source-return discrepancies and large changes without trimming after looking. Reproduce old additive CAR where valid. All split/price/share unit issues isolated from total-return outcome.
inference: Equal weight per review;95% t interval on review means and symmetric review sign flips. Primary adds2017–2025 only. Exact sign flips for<=20reviews, deterministic Monte Carlo otherwise; leave-one-review-out and descriptive dispersion; results are exploratory and repeated issuers remain a limitation.
cost_sensitivity: Show gross result and net after assumed incremental execution penalty10,25,50basis points per early-traded notional; these are scenarios, not measured fees. EOD bid/ask spread diagnostic only if both dates yield noncrossed positive quotes; ratio to midpoint makes split scale cancel within each date. No claimed auction fill.
risk: Per-event dispersion, loss share, review-level worst comparison, interim relative-return path and peak absolute deviation. No full-index annualized tracking error without verified weights and complete portfolio.
annual_cost_gate: No annual savings or SEK savings without verified as-of index weights/full membership and supported fund mandates/AUM. Do not substitute companycap*classshares weights as exact.
